purpose: Define the unified public Tata-inspired C0/C1 site-scope physical-economic model scaffold before any unified modelbuilder implementation.

configuration_set.current_status: static S3.3j validation foundation plus S4.3b static-settled electricity baseline

configuration_set.configuration_role: hybrid BF-BOF plus DRP-EAF transition case
configuration_set.current_status: S3.3j boundary-aligned plus S3.4/S4.2e DRP/EAF-scoped DA prototype

policy_modes.objective_price_treatment: no response to hourly DA variation
policy_modes.settlement_reporting_price_treatment: may settle fixed or smoothed schedule against realised DAM for comparison
policy_modes.production_target_treatment: same hard final-product target as DA policy
policy_modes.terminal_inventory_treatment: same terminal rules as DA policy
policy_modes.allowed_flexible_decisions: only physically represented decisions not driven by hourly DA prices
policy_modes.benchmark_interpretation: price-insensitive physical reference settled ex post
policy_modes.expected_outputs: solver stats if solved; physical schedule; ex-post cost; final-product fulfilment; caveats

policy_modes.objective_price_treatment: real hourly DAM prices may enter objective for supported electricity demand
policy_modes.settlement_reporting_price_treatment: same DAM window and units as objective
policy_modes.production_target_treatment: same hard final-product target as price-naive policy
policy_modes.terminal_inventory_treatment: same terminal rules as price-naive policy
policy_modes.allowed_flexible_decisions: only decisions present in the configuration topology and bounded by constraints
policy_modes.benchmark_interpretation: deterministic price-taking comparison not bidding and not oracle
policy_modes.expected_outputs: solver stats; physical schedule; DA cost; external costs; EUR/t final product; caveats

prototype_status.s3_3j: frozen static calibrated and boundary-aligned process-network foundation
prototype_status.s3_4_s4_0a: C1 DRP/EAF guardrail wrapper with development-only inputs
prototype_status.s4_1_to_s4_2e: C1 DRP/EAF-scoped deterministic DA prototype and benchmark on modelled external costs
prototype_status.s4_3b_c0: static-settled C0 gross-electricity baseline not true DA optimisation
